sealed_record.thesis: The market is valuing ENA off the corpse of its old business: USDe market cap peaked near $15b around Oct 2025 and has bled to roughly $4-5b by mid-2026, so consensus reads Ethena as a dead crypto-perp basis trade with decaying funding. What that misses is the input change flagged by no_alfa_here on 2026-09-26 — farming basis on EQUITY perps (HIP-3 style venues) rather than crypto perps, which scales with listed-equity float instead of crypto open interest, has structurally lower funding volatility, and is positively skewed because equity funding is persistently long-biased. If equity-perp collateral becomes a meaningful share of USDe backing, the yield stops being a crypto-beta function and starts being a carry function, which is a different and far higher multiple. Nobody is repricing that yet because the headline USDe chart still points down.
